visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a title card showing a white food container filled with fresh green broccoli florets. Text overlays indicate a cooking tutorial. The setting is a clean, well-lit kitchen with a soft focus background. (2) A person's hands are shown at a white kitchen sink. They hold a whole head of broccoli under a stream of running water, shaking it vigorously inside a metal bowl to wash it. (3) The person adds a splash of vinegar from a clear bottle and a sprinkle of white powder from a small jar into the bowl of water. They then submerge the broccoli and place a blue-and-white striped ceramic bowl upside down on top of it to keep it underwater. (4) On a yellow cutting board, the hands use a large kitchen knife to cut the large broccoli head into individual florets. The camera shows close-up shots of the knife removing leaves and slicing through the stems. (5) The hands use a vegetable peeler to remove the tough outer skin from a thick broccoli stem. Small green shavings are visible on the board. The florets are then split by hand or sliced to ensure uniform size. (6) The person trims the broccoli core into bite-sized chunks using diagonal cuts. Each piece is handled with precision. (7) Individual florets are rinsed again under a faucet. The person uses their fingers to spread the florets open, checking for debris or insects. The broccoli is then shaken in a metal strainer to drain. (8) In a kitchen setting with a blue Dutch oven on an induction cooktop, the person adds a pinch of salt to boiling water. They carefully place the broccoli florets into the hot water using a plate. (9) After a short boil, a slotted spoon is used to lift the bright green broccoli out of the pot and immediately transfer it into a bowl of cold water to stop the cooking process. (10) The blanched broccoli is drained in a strainer and then packed into white ceramic storage containers with red floral patterns. The person snaps red plastic lids onto the containers. (11) The final shot shows the prepped broccoli stored in the containers on a kitchen counter, accompanied by social media handle text overlays.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 料理小教室 如何清洗分切花椰菜. (2) [Subtitle]: 清洗青花菜/花椰菜要先整朵洗... (3) [Subtitle]: 像這樣用力的甩動利用水流，反覆的清洗. (4) [Subtitle]: 換一桶水再洗一次. (5) [Subtitle]: 浸泡的時候你可以放一點醋，或者貝殼粉等（不過我覺得根本不需要...）. (6) [Subtitle]: 上面蓋一個碗，固定一下！ (7) [Subtitle]: 像這樣大概泡個3-5分鐘. (8) [Subtitle]: 整朵浸泡好了之後再來分切！ (9) [Subtitle]: 將旁邊的葉子切掉，青花菜切成小朵. (10) [Subtitle]: 一朵一朵分切下來即可. (11) [Subtitle]: 中間的部分切斷.. (12) [Subtitle]: 同樣分切成小朵. (13) [Subtitle]: 盡量讓每一朵都一樣大小. (14) [Subtitle]: 比較大朵的部分，可以刨掉老皮吃起來會比較嫩. (15) [Subtitle]: 這個是小朵. (16) [Subtitle]: 這是大朵. (17) [Subtitle]: 大朵的中間切開一刀. (18) [Subtitle]: 像這樣撕開來就能變成小朵... (19) [Subtitle]: 每一朵就能一樣大小了... (20) [Subtitle]: 切成一樣大小的話，這樣煮的時候熟度就會比較一致... (21) [Subtitle]: 菜心的部分，底部切掉一塊. (22) [Subtitle]: 再將外皮切除掉.. (23) [Subtitle]: 保留菜心嫩嫩的部分. (24) [Subtitle]: 菜心再切成滾刀塊即可. (25) [Subtitle]: 最後每一朵一一掰開來檢查，確認沒有蟲.. (26) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾水分，就可以煮囉！ (27) [Subtitle]: 燙青菜，可以水裡加入兩撮鹽調味. (28) [Subtitle]: 等水滾再來燙蔬菜. (29) [Subtitle]: 把青花菜或花椰菜放進來. (30) [Subtitle]: 水滾之後大約燙1分半~2分鐘左右（看自己喜歡的口感）. (31) [Subtitle]: 撈起來，立刻放到冷水裡降溫. (32) [Subtitle]: 這樣可以維持蔬菜翠綠的顏色！ (33) [Subtitle]: 用冰水（飲用水）大約泡2分鐘左右. (34) [Subtitle]: 最後瀝乾水分. (35) [Subtitle]: 你可以煮多一點放到保鮮盒裡面. (36) [Subtitle]: 像這樣大概可以冰箱冷藏5天左右.. (37) [Subtitle]: 常備的花椰菜，冰箱取出來就可以直接吃不需要加熱！！ (38) [Subtitle]: 也可以變化成各種花椰菜的料理！ (39) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @Rosali.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio features a steady, upbeat acoustic BGM track consisting of a cheerful piano melody layered with a plucked rhythmic guitar. The tempo is moderate and the mood is productive. (2) A sharp splash and the sound of turbulent running water are heard as the vegetable is placed under the faucet. This is followed by a rhythmic 'swishing' sound of water in a bowl. (3) A distinct mechanical 'click' occurs as a bottle is opened, followed by a soft 'plop' of a bowl being placed on water. The BGM remains continuous in the background. (4) Sharp, resonant 'thud' and 'slice' sounds from a knife hitting a wooden board occur at frequent intervals, synchronized with the visual cutting of the broccoli. (5) A textured 'scraping' sound represents the action of the peeler against the broccoli stem. This is a shorter, more abrasive sound event compared to the knife cuts. (6) A high-frequency water rushing sound returns as the florets are rinsed individually. (7) A low-frequency bubbling sound indicates water in a pot, followed by a 'clatter' as the broccoli is transferred into a bowl. (8) A percussive 'snap' and 'click' sound marks the final phase as plastic lids are secured onto the containers. The BGM then fades out as the video concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a practical instructional guide designed to teach home cooks an efficient and hygienic method for preparing broccoli. It emphasizes thorough cleaning (including soaking and rinsing individual florets), uniform cutting for even cooking, and blanching to maintain color and texture, ultimately promoting organized meal prepping.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency jump cuts and close-up framing to maintain a fast, engaging pace. The absence of narration is compensated for by detailed on-screen text and realistic foley sounds.
